For each feasible \(z\):

- \(z=0\): \(0 \le y \le 10\), so \(11\) solutions.
- \(z=1\): \(0 \le y \le 7\), so \(8\) solutions.
- \(z=2\): \(0 \le y \le 5\), so \(6\) solutions.
- \(z=3\): \(0 \le y \le 2\), so \(3\) solutions.
- \(z=4\): \(0 \le y \le 0\), so \(1\) solution.

Total: \(11+8+6+3+1=29\).

\boxed{29}
